dc_eval_cbrn.note: No CBRN domain named anywhere; 'national security ... risks' (Sec 2) is unspecified and about Claude 2-era models; 2.1 appendix has only long-context and honesty evals.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: ARC 'autonomous replication' determination covers 'our current Claude models' as of the Claude 2 card (July 2023), written before 2.1 existed; 2.1 appendix reports no autonomy eval for 2.1. Evaluations are events on earlier models, not inherited by 'remains similar'.

dc_eval_scheming.note: 2.1 honesty evals are factual accuracy/faithfulness (hallucination), not deception framed as misalignment risk.

framework_threshold.note: No RSP or other framework named.

ext_test_any.note: External red teamers and ARC tested Claude 2 / a Claude snapshot before Claude 2 deployment; card does not say outsiders tested Claude 2.1.

ext_test_named_org.note: ARC named, but its audits are of earlier Claude models, not tied to 2.1.

ext_test_government.note: Only 'working with policymakers ... to share our findings'; generic, not government testing.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: 'Before deployment' external red teaming refers to Claude 2, not 2.1.

safeguards_training.quote:
Using this Constitution, models are trained to avoid sexist, racist, and toxic outputs, as well as to avoid
helping a human engage in illegal or unethical activities.
safeguards_training.note: Appendix: 2.1 builds on Claude 2.0 and 'In most other respects, Claude 2.1 remains similar to Claude 2.0', so the 2.0 safety training (a model property) carries over.

safeguards_runtime.note: 'Trust and Safety processes, which help enforce our AUP' names no mechanism (no classifier/filter/monitoring).
